elaine: Hey — PR #3421 (migration guide + SDK example) is blocked. Need a quick runtime confirmation about prefetch cache ordering vs route/prefix cache before we update the docs. CI/docs-preview also flagged a linkcheck error but that can be fixed later. main blocker is behavior.

sam: Can you paste the config snippet you're trying to document? Curious which level the prefetch is configured at. :eyes:

elaine: snippet from the PR: ```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  sources: [embedding_store]
  cache_key_template: "user:{user_id}:prefetch"
route_cache:
  prefix_match: "/psi/"
  ttl: 60s
```
We're describing it as "prefetch populates the route cache" but runtime said earlier it might not.

michael: tagging reviewers — we'll need 1 docs + 1 runtime. This is a merge-window candidate but don't merge until runtime confirms ordering.

deploy-bot: docs-preview finished: linkcheck failed on 1 URL -> /migration/prefetch#examples (404). log: `LinkChecker: 1 broken link(s) found`

riyad: digging in. Quick answer: prefetch runs at request ingress (before routing decision) and writes into the global KV cache. Route/prefix cache is consulted during generation; if a route cache key matches a generated prefix it will be used to short-circuit model decoding. So ordering is: prefetch -> routing -> generation (prefix cache). Prefetch does not automatically merge into a route cache key unless the key templates align. TTLs are respected at read time. :white_check_mark:

sam: ok — so our docs sentence that said "prefetch populates route cache" is misleading. We should say "prefetch can populate the global KV that route cache reads from if keys align" — can you confirm any edgecases (race with streaming, or per-request overrides)?

riyad: good call. Edgecases: 1) streaming: if streaming generation starts before prefetch write completes (very rare), you may see no cache hit — prefetch is synchronous at ingress by default, but customers can set async=true which would cause races. 2) per-request override: route-level `cache.enabled=false` will disable prefix short-circuits even if KV has entries. 3) key collisions: different services using same template can overwrite — recommend namespacing.

elaine: perfect — will edit PR wording and update the SDK snippet to show key namespacing. Proposed doc sentence: "Prefetch runs at ingress and writes to the global KV store. Route-level prefix caches consult the KV store during generation; a cache hit requires matching key templates and enabled route caching. Async prefetch or disabled route cache are common reasons for a miss."

elaine: updated the PR with a small patch (excerpt): ```yaml
# recommended: namespace the key per-service
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  async: false
  cache_key_template: "service:recommendations:user:{user_id}:prefetch"
route_cache:
  prefix_match: "/recommend/"
  ttl: 60s
  enabled: true
```

michael: thanks, that's clear. docs LGTM aside from the linkcheck 404 — probably a bad anchor. I'll approve once the link is fixed. :thumbsup:

elaine: fixed the anchor in migration anchor file and pushed. Also added a one-line "what changed" blurb for release notes.

sam: canary plan? I'm happy to merge to canary branch and run a quick smoke on staging routes.

riyad: sounds good. I'll watch for any unexpected cache-miss reports.

michael: approved. merging to canary now. :rocket:

elaine: merged — closing thread. Thanks everyone!
